cssbuy-returns-refunds-after-qc.title: CSSBuy Returns After QC: Evidence, Deadlines and Refunds
cssbuy-returns-refunds-after-qc.seoTitle: CSSBuy Returns & Refunds After QC: What to Do
cssbuy-returns-refunds-after-qc.description: Found a wrong size or defect in CSSBuy QC photos? Learn what evidence to save, how to request a return and why a seller refund differs from a balance withdrawal.
cssbuy-returns-refunds-after-qc.research: Based on CSSBuy’s public return conditions, order-support instructions and refund help, checked October 16, 2026. The evidence log and worked example below are editorial tools, not a promise that a seller will accept a return.

sections: Quick answer: act on the order before planning the parcel

If your CSSBuy QC photos show a wrong option, missing piece or visible defect, save the evidence and contact support on that order promptly. Ask whether the seller will accept a return, what deadline applies and what you would pay. Keep the disputed item out of a parcel while you request clarification. A warehouse arrival or an uploaded photograph is not your own acceptance decision, and shipping an unresolved item abroad can make a practical remedy harder.

CSSBuy’s public FAQ describes return assistance subject to seller acceptance, fewer than seven days in the warehouse and payment of return freight. Treat this as a reason to check immediately, not as a guaranteed seven-day right for every item. Ask support to confirm the applicable conditions and exact deadline in your order record. A longer storage allowance does not extend a seller’s return window.
1. Separate a mismatch from missing evidence

Reopen the saved listing and the actual purchased option. Compare size, colour, model, quantity and included accessories against the order record before comparing appearance. A listing’s first picture may show a different option. For clothing, a size label alone cannot establish fit; use a relevant measurement and the same measuring method as the seller’s chart. For a set, count the pieces that the selected option actually included.

Classify each concern as confirmed mismatch, uncertain from the image, or acceptable for your intended use. An unclear angle needs a targeted photo, not an unsupported defect claim. Ask for the one close-up, label view or measurement that would change your decision. Visual QC can help document condition, but it cannot certify authenticity, hidden materials or long-term durability.
2. Build a short evidence log

Save the CSSBuy order number, source link, ordered variant, warehouse arrival timestamp and the relevant QC images. Write one sentence describing what was ordered and one describing what is visible. Keep original images as well as an annotated copy; point to the relevant area without editing the underlying evidence. Record when you contacted support and the latest reply so a later follow-up refers to the same unresolved question.

Do not post a whole account screenshot publicly to ask whether a defect is obvious. Crop unrelated orders, addresses, payment information and account identifiers from any image you choose to share. Support needs enough information to locate the order through the official channel; other shoppers normally need only the product detail and the specific problem.
3. Ask for a return on the relevant order

CSSBuy’s public support page directs purchase and return questions to the relevant order in My Order using Add Note. Interface wording may vary. Open the order you are disputing rather than a different parcel. State the requested outcome: return, exchange, or a specific extra inspection before you decide. Ask for confirmation that the request reached the team and whether any action is needed before the deadline.

A useful message says: “Order [number], ordered [option]. QC image [reference] shows [specific mismatch]. Please confirm whether the seller accepts a return, the deadline, return freight and any other deduction. Please clarify the next step before this item is included in an international parcel.” Replace every bracket with your own verified detail. This format records a request without assuming approval or inventing a promised refund amount.
4. Compare the remedy and its actual cost

Before approving a return, ask which amounts are refundable and which are not: product price, original Chinese delivery, return freight and any selected service. Keep unknown amounts marked as unknown. If an exchange is offered, check availability of the replacement option, any extra domestic shipping and whether the replacement will be inspected again. An exchange also changes the arrival calendar for other items you intended to consolidate.

Consider a fictional order with a 120 CNY item, 10 CNY original delivery and a quoted 15 CNY return charge. If only the 120 CNY product amount is refundable, the two freight amounts total 25 CNY in unrecovered expense; this is not a CSSBuy fee schedule. Your own result depends on confirmed credits, deductions and any separately paid service. Compare that documented outcome with keeping an item you can actually use, rather than comparing against an assumed full refund.
5. Track the seller refund and balance separately

Seller acceptance, physical return, refund processing and an account credit are distinct events. Save the confirmation at each stage and reconcile the amount against the order. If the record only says that a request was submitted, do not treat the money as available. Ask a focused follow-up about the last completed step and the next required action rather than opening several unrelated requests for the same item.

A refund visible as CSSBuy balance is not proof that money has reached your bank or original payment provider. CSSBuy publishes a separate balance-refund process. Check the currently available refund destination, eligibility, charges and status in your account before making that request. Keep the payment-channel confirmation as a separate record. This guide does not promise a processing time or that every charge returns through the same method.
6. Close the case before consolidating

Update your item list with a final decision: keep, return accepted, replacement pending or unresolved. Only accepted items should enter your intended parcel list. Recalculate the weight and packing plan if a returned item is removed; the remaining parcel may have a different cost per item. Check each remaining storage deadline independently rather than assuming all items share the date of the newest arrival.

Keep the source listing, QC evidence, support replies and financial records together until the outcome is settled. The useful result is a traceable decision, not a collection of screenshots with no dates. For future orders, save the exact variant and seller conditions before payment and decide in advance which photo or measurement you would need at warehouse arrival. That makes the next QC review faster and more specific.

cssbuy-shipping-to-brazil.description: Estimate CSSBuy shipping to Brazil with packed weight, dimensions and eligible routes. Compare packaging, keep taxes separate and prepare CPF and delivery records.
cssbuy-shipping-to-brazil.research: Checked against CSSBuy’s public estimator and buying workflow, Correios international-receipt guidance and Receita Federal’s import-cost information. The worked parcel dimensions are fictional. This article quotes no live route, tax rate or delivery guarantee.

sections: Quick answer: estimate the packed parcel, not just the products

CSSBuy shipping to Brazil has no single price per shopping basket. Start with your Brazilian destination, the actual goods, a realistic packed weight and exterior dimensions. Use those inputs in CSSBuy’s current estimator, then compare only routes that accept the contents. Keep international freight separate from product price, Chinese delivery, optional services and import charges. The cheapest visible freight figure is not necessarily the lowest complete cost.

CSSBuy describes an initial shipping deposit based on estimates and a final freight calculation using verified parcel size and weight. That is why a number obtained before packing can differ from the later charge. Save the first estimate as a planning reference, and record the final packed measurements and quote separately. If a charge changes, compare the inputs and selected services before assuming that the rate itself changed.
1. Check contents and destination before comparing prices

List every item and any relevant attribute, including batteries, liquids, fragile parts or other restrictions shown by the service. Check both purchase acceptance and international route eligibility; one does not establish the other. A mixed parcel must satisfy the chosen route for all its contents. Do not describe a restricted item as a different product to obtain a quote. Ask for clarification while you still have a practical choice about the purchase or packing plan.

Use the actual delivery address and postal code for the comparison. Availability can depend on destination and parcel characteristics, so a screenshot from another buyer is only a lead to investigate. Record the quote date, currency, route conditions, tracking arrangement and exclusions. A route name or promotional label alone does not establish which charges are prepaid or which import programme applies to your purchase.
2. Understand actual and volumetric weight

Actual weight is the packed parcel’s measured mass. Volumetric weight is a size-based calculation where the selected route uses one. For a route using centimetres and a specified divisor, the worksheet calculation is length × width × height ÷ divisor. Use the route’s own billing and rounding rules rather than assuming all services charge on the same basis. Product weights added together leave out packaging and do not describe exterior volume.

For a fictional example, assume a route compares actual and volumetric weight using a divisor of 6,000. A 3.2 kg parcel measuring 40 × 30 × 25 cm has a volumetric weight of 5 kg, so 5 kg would be the comparison result before any rounding. These numbers are a teaching example, not a current Brazil route quotation. The real divisor, minimum billable weight, increments and limits must come from the option you actually select.
3. Compare packing scenarios with equal protection needs

Continue the fictional example with a smaller 35 × 25 × 20 cm exterior and a new measured weight of 3 kg. Using the same assumed divisor, volumetric weight becomes about 2.92 kg and the larger comparison value is 3 kg. That illustrates why dimensions can matter, but it does not predict a saving: the smaller packing must be feasible, protect the contents and remain eligible for the same route. Only a fresh quote converts the changed inputs into money.

Compare keeping retail boxes, removing unnecessary packaging and adding targeted protection as separate scenarios. Soft clothing and a structured bag do not have the same packing needs. Record what may be removed and what must remain protected; vague instructions to remove everything can conflict with your priorities. Recheck QC and return decisions before consolidation, and avoid delaying older items simply because one replacement has not arrived.
4. Keep import charges outside the freight subtotal

Build the complete budget as separate rows: goods, Chinese delivery, selected services, international freight, insurance where applicable, and estimated import charges. Label whether each row is paid, quoted or unknown. Do not count a balance top-up and the later spending of that same balance as two product costs. If the shipping deposit is adjusted later, link the adjustment to the original entry instead of adding an unrelated expense.

Receita Federal’s official guidance explains that customs value includes goods, freight and insurance where applicable. The applicable calculation depends on the purchase’s actual programme status and destination rules. Use the current official guidance and calculator for your circumstances; do not assume a CSSBuy route name proves Remessa Conforme participation or prepaid taxes. Keep receipts and accurate item descriptions available, and do not use an invented declared value as a cost-saving method.
5. Prepare the recipient and delivery records

For postal imports handled by Correios, its international-receipt guidance calls for a regular CPF and a recipient name matching Receita Federal’s records. Check those details before dispatch rather than waiting for an exception. Monitor Minhas Importações for the postal shipment’s documentation or payment requirements. If another carrier handles the delivery, follow that carrier’s verified process instead of assuming every route uses the same portal.

Save the parcel reference, carrier tracking number, goods receipts, packing measurements and charges paid in one record. A label created, a warehouse departure and customs clearance are different events. Use the last confirmed scan and date when asking about a delay. A published transit estimate is not a customs-clearance deadline, and this guide cannot promise when a particular parcel will arrive.
6. Make the final route decision from comparable quotes

Shortlist eligible routes only after you have accepted the items and chosen protection. Compare final chargeable weight, dated freight, services, exclusions and the delivery process using the worksheet above. If you compare one parcel with two parcels, include the separate charges and packing for both; splitting is not automatically cheaper. Choose based on the complete documented trade-off, and keep a reserve for amounts that remain unknown rather than entering them as zero.

find-original-product-link-cssbuy.label: PRODUCT LINKS
find-original-product-link-cssbuy.title: How to Find the Original Product Link on CSSBuy
find-original-product-link-cssbuy.description: Recover a CSSBuy product’s original Taobao, Weidian or 1688 link from saved listings and order records. Check item IDs, sellers and variants before ordering again.
find-original-product-link-cssbuy.research: Based on CSSBuy’s public link-based buying workflow and the source-ID mapping used by this site’s catalogue. CSSBuy interfaces and link formats vary; there is no assumed universal Original Link button.

table.title: Do not confuse these five identifiers
table.intro: A number only becomes useful when you know which platform and record it belongs to.
rows: A listing on its original platform
The product record within that platform
The specific size, colour or bundle

sections: Quick answer: start with the saved source, not a guessed URL

To find the original link for a CSSBuy product, first reopen the spreadsheet entry, bookmark, message or order record that led you to it. Look for the marketplace name and its product URL. If the record has only a CSSBuy link, inspect the visible product information and any source reference shown there. When the source remains unclear, ask CSSBuy support on the relevant order to identify the original listing.

CSSBuy’s public buying instructions confirm that shoppers can paste a marketplace product link into its search field and then choose an option. That establishes the direction from source listing to agent order; it does not prove that every CSSBuy screen exposes a reverse-link button. A reliable recovery process matches evidence across records instead of assuming that the first number in any address is the original item ID.
1. Recover the earliest link you saved

Check the original spreadsheet cell, not only the text displayed in it. A cell labelled “buy” may point to an agent page, a redirect or a marketplace. On a phone, use the browser’s link-copy or link-preview action to see the destination without changing the spreadsheet. Search your own saved messages and bookmarks for the product name and purchase date. Keep a copy of the recovered address before following a redirect, so you can compare where it leads.

If you already placed an order, compare this recovered link with that order’s product title, seller reference and chosen option. Your CSSBuy order number is useful for support, but it is not a marketplace item ID. Keep the two in different columns. This avoids a common mistake: pasting an internal purchase number into a marketplace URL and reaching an unrelated item or an error page.
2. Read an ID only in its platform context

Some CSSBuy product addresses expose parameters such as type and id. Their meaning depends on the link format and source marketplace. Do not convert an arbitrary id into a Taobao, Weidian or 1688 address just because it is numeric. Preserve the full link, identify the marketplace from an explicit source record, and verify the resulting listing against the seller and product. If those checks fail, leave the source unresolved rather than fabricating a match.

In this site’s catalogue, the product page displays a source Product ID and the purchase button passes that Weidian source ID to CSSBuy. The catalogue page’s own numeric filename is a different identifier. For example, a saved catalogue row and its source item can legitimately have different numbers. Read the labelled source field rather than copying the catalogue URL’s filename. This is a description of this catalogue, not a conversion rule for every CSSBuy link on the web.
3. Confirm seller, listing and selected option

A recovered page is a candidate until it matches the record you intended to find. Compare the marketplace, item ID, shop, model details, option names and included pieces. Reused product photographs are weak evidence on their own. The same image can appear in multiple shops, and a seller can change a listing after you save it. Record the date of your comparison and any difference instead of treating an old screenshot as the current offer.

Before ordering again, reselect the size, colour and quantity and inspect the configured price. Finding the original item does not restore the previous stock, price or seller conditions. A matching product ID also does not select the same SKU automatically. Save a new option record if you proceed, and keep the earlier order as historical evidence rather than overwriting it.
4. Handle a dead link without claiming an exact recovery

A page that no longer opens may be removed, unavailable in your current session or replaced by another listing. Keep the saved source ID and seller information before searching again. Search by the known product name and distinctive details; image search can suggest visually similar candidates. Open each candidate and repeat the identity and option checks. A similar image is a starting point for research, not proof of the same seller, materials or stock.

If you locate a replacement offer, label it as a new candidate and save its own marketplace URL. Do not silently replace the old link in a shared record and imply continuity. This matters when other people use your QC notes: evidence from an earlier seller or batch cannot establish the condition of a new purchase. Keep the old and new records connected with a note explaining what changed and what still needs checking.
When all you have is a shared screenshot

Suppose a friend sends a screenshot of a shoe with a price and a CSSBuy page header, but no readable URL. First ask for the shareable product link or the original spreadsheet row. A price and picture alone cannot identify one marketplace listing. If your friend bought it, they can check their own order record and share the product source without exposing their account. You do not need their login, order history or delivery details to research the item.

If a source link cannot be recovered, treat an image-search result as a fresh candidate. Compare the visible model details, seller, sizing options and current configured price. Keep a note that the original source was not confirmed. For example, two offers may use the same photograph while one sells a single piece and another sells a bundle. Until the option and seller checks are complete, neither the familiar photograph nor a similar price justifies calling it the same listing.
5. Ask support with a precise reference

When your purchase record exists but the marketplace source is missing, contact CSSBuy through the relevant order. Provide the order number and saved product reference, explain that you want the original seller listing, and ask whether it is still available. This is more useful than sending an isolated photograph and asking for “the same link.” Do not send passwords or payment credentials; they are not needed to identify a product listing.

Once resolved, keep four fields together: original marketplace URL, CSSBuy product URL, exact selected option and order number. Add the seller name, checked date and any unresolved limitation. Reopen the source before your next purchase. This small record makes later price comparisons, QC questions and return requests easier because each discussion refers to the same listing and the same purchased variant.
